## Analysis and Proof {#vol-05 .section-title}

```{=html}
<section class="wh-hero geo-mountains">
  <div class="wh-hero__body">
    <div class="wh-hero__left">
      <p>Up until now, you have relied on assumptions about how numbers behave between points. This volume strips away those assumptions and rebuilds mathematics on a rigorous foundation of limits, instantaneous rates of change, and continuous accumulation.</p>
      <p>By the end you will understand how to freeze a changing system precisely at a moment in time, how to add up an infinite number of infinitely small pieces, and how to construct a logical argument that proves something must be true — not just probably, but necessarily.</p>
      <div class="wh-hero__actions">
        <a class="wh-hero__btn wh-hero__btn--primary" href="./01-limits-continuity.html">Start Volume 5</a>

        <div class="wh-hero-card">
          <div class="wh-hero-card__type">Central move</div>
          <div class="wh-hero-card__title">Taming the infinite</div>
          <div class="wh-hero-card__dek">Calculus is the mathematics of change and accumulation at the infinitesimally small scale. This volume builds it from its foundations — limits — through to engineering applications.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="wh-hero-card">
          <div class="wh-hero-card__type">Info</div>
          <div class="wh-hero-card__title">Prerequisite</div>

        </div>
```

## Chapter Map {#chapter-map .section-title}

```{=html}
<div class="wh-book-grid wh-reveal">
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Ch 1</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title"><a href="./01-limits-continuity.html">Limits and continuity</a></div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Approaching the boundary. The formal definition of a limit, continuity, and why these ideas are the foundation all of calculus is built on.</div>
  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Ch 2</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title"><a href="./02-differential-calculus.html">Differential calculus</a></div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Measuring instantaneous change. Derivatives as limits of difference quotients, differentiation rules, and the chain rule — with geometric and physical interpretation throughout.</div>
  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Ch 3</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title"><a href="./03-integral-calculus.html">Integral calculus</a></div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Accumulating continuous amounts. The definite integral as a limit of Riemann sums, the Fundamental Theorem, and integration techniques including substitution and parts.</div>
  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Ch 4</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title"><a href="./04-proof-reasoning.html">Proof and reasoning</a></div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Establishing absolute certainty. Direct proof, contradiction, induction — the logical structures that separate "this always works" from "this happened to work."</div>
  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Ch 5</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title"><a href="./05-series-numerical.html">Series expansions and numerical methods</a></div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Approximating functions and finding zeros. Taylor and Maclaurin series, convergence tests, Newton's method — because most real problems don't have closed-form solutions.</div>
  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Ch 6</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title"><a href="./06-integral-engineering.html">Engineering integral applications</a></div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Centroids, second moments, and RMS values. Integration applied to the physical quantities that structural, electrical, and mechanical engineering depend on.</div>
  </article>
</div>
```
